page.text:
Before formalizing subgroups, we establish an elementary set-theoretic
lemma: the Cartesian product of a subset with itself is a subset of the
Cartesian square of the ambient set. This lemma guarantees that
restricting a binary operation $* : X \times X \to X$ to $X' \times X'$
yields a well-typed mapping into $X$.
